title: tc-ai-answer
description: An assistant's answer with its sources, citation chips, actions, feedback and follow-up questions.

sources.description: The sources the answer cites, numbered from 1 in the order given – [1] in the answer is the first

answer.description: The answer text – may grow while `streaming` is set

streaming.description: More text is still coming from your model, keep the cursor going

animated.description: Stream the text in; false shows it at once

speed.description: Words per second while streaming in

followUps.description: Follow-up questions offered under the finished answer

feedbackReasons.description: Reasons offered after a thumbs down

hideActions.description: Leave out the built-in actions under a finished answer (copy, regenerate, thumbs and the status beside them) – for an app that puts its own row there, such as `tc-message-actions`. Stop still shows while the answer is written

title.description: Headline of the page, message or document

name.description: Short name shown on the citation chip, e.g. "Notion"

snippet.description: The passage the answer relies on – shown in the preview
